Auto-discovery idea: LaminB1 boundary-distance contrast as an orthogonal lamina fidelity test¶

Rationale¶

Builds on direction evidence_extension-3df4217e10 from the supported parent idea pan-cell-lamina-to-radial-fidelity-score-1b358815a3, but replaces the prior LaminB1-versus-radial-score correlation with a direct nuclear-periphery distance contrast.

Hypothesis and data¶

If LaminB1 marks lamina-proximal chromatin, spots with high tracks.LaminB1 should have smaller tracks.n_per_dist(um) than matched LaminB1-low spots within the same cells, across Granule, Bergmann, and Purkinje cells.

Analysis sketch¶

Within each eligible cell, split spots into top and bottom LaminB1 quartiles, compute the median periphery-distance difference, then aggregate cell-level differences with a one-sample signed-rank or permutation sign-flip test.

Expected result¶

The parameter should be negative: LaminB1-high loci are expected to lie closer to the nuclear periphery than LaminB1-low loci.

Validation checks¶

Verify required fields, minimum cells and spot counts per cell, finite effect size, p-value from sign-flip/permutation test, runtime under budget, deterministic rerun, and a negative control using shuffled LaminB1 labels within cells.

Exploration¶

The code agent can freely add cells below this point.

Critique and compact plan¶

This subset has only nine cells (three per requested cell type), so the analysis should avoid over-interpreting cell-level significance. I will use the proposed within-cell contrast as the operational unit: for each eligible cell, compare median tracks.n_per_dist(um) among top-quartile versus bottom-quartile tracks.LaminB1 spots after requiring finite values. The main inferential check will be a bounded, deterministic within-cell permutation/randomization test that shuffles LaminB1 values inside each cell and recomputes the median cell-level contrast, preserving each cell's periphery-distance distribution and sample size. A secondary sign summary is reported descriptively, but the permutation test is the explicit hypothesis test. The figure will show observed cell contrasts and the permutation null distribution so the tested statistic is visible.

# Main exploration: within-cell LaminB1 quartile contrast in nuclear-periphery distance.
import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLBACKEND', 'Agg')
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg', force=True)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import display, Image

rng = np.random.default_rng(20250214)
TARGET_CELL_TYPES = ['Granule', 'Bergmann', 'Purkinje']
MIN_FINITE_SPOTS_PER_CELL = 40
N_PERMUTATIONS = 500
REL_RESULT_PATH = 'tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/iterative_2x10_litsearch_rounds/iteration_02/laminb1-boundary-distance-contrast-as-an-orthogo-dd91a4bb3c_result.csv'
REL_FIG_PATH = 'tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/iterative_2x10_litsearch_rounds/iteration_02/laminb1-boundary-distance-contrast-as-an-orthogo-dd91a4bb3c_statistical_summary.png'
result_path_abs = PROJECT_ROOT / REL_RESULT_PATH
fig_path_abs = PROJECT_ROOT / REL_FIG_PATH
result_path_abs.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Assemble a spot-level analysis frame. Tracks are aligned row-wise with cdata.spots in this h5cd.
coords = np.asarray(cdata.coords)
spots_df = cdata.spots[['cell_id', 'chrom', 'start', 'end', 'trace_id', 'name']].copy()
tracks_df = cdata.tracks[['LaminB1', 'n_per_dist(um)']].copy()
analysis_df = pd.concat([spots_df.reset_index(drop=True), tracks_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
analysis_df['coord_x_um'] = coords[:, 0]
analysis_df['coord_y_um'] = coords[:, 1]
analysis_df['coord_z_um'] = coords[:, 2]

cells_df = cdata.cells.reset_index().rename(columns={cdata.cells.index.name or 'index': 'cell_id'})
# If reset_index produced a generic column not named cell_id, normalize it.
if 'cell_id' not in cells_df.columns:
    first_col = cells_df.columns[0]
    cells_df = cells_df.rename(columns={first_col: 'cell_id'})
cells_df['cell_id_str'] = cells_df['cell_id'].astype(str)
analysis_df['cell_id_str'] = analysis_df['cell_id'].astype(str)
analysis_df = analysis_df.merge(cells_df[['cell_id_str', 'cell_type']], on='cell_id_str', how='left')

finite_mask = (
    analysis_df['cell_type'].isin(TARGET_CELL_TYPES)
    & np.isfinite(pd.to_numeric(analysis_df['LaminB1'], errors='coerce'))
    & np.isfinite(pd.to_numeric(analysis_df['n_per_dist(um)'], errors='coerce'))
    & np.isfinite(analysis_df[['coord_x_um', 'coord_y_um', 'coord_z_um']]).all(axis=1)
)
eligible_df = analysis_df.loc[finite_mask].copy()

cell_rows = []
cell_payloads = []
for cell_id, g in eligible_df.groupby('cell_id_str', sort=True):
    g = g.copy()
    n_finite = len(g)
    if n_finite < MIN_FINITE_SPOTS_PER_CELL:
        continue
    q25 = float(g['LaminB1'].quantile(0.25))
    q75 = float(g['LaminB1'].quantile(0.75))
    low = g['LaminB1'] <= q25
    high = g['LaminB1'] >= q75
    n_low = int(low.sum())
    n_high = int(high.sum())
    if n_low < 5 or n_high < 5 or q75 <= q25:
        continue
    high_median = float(g.loc[high, 'n_per_dist(um)'].median())
    low_median = float(g.loc[low, 'n_per_dist(um)'].median())
    contrast = high_median - low_median
    cell_type = str(g['cell_type'].iloc[0])
    cell_rows.append({
        'cell_id': cell_id,
        'cell_type': cell_type,
        'n_finite_spots': int(n_finite),
        'n_low_quartile_spots': n_low,
        'n_high_quartile_spots': n_high,
        'laminB1_q25': q25,
        'laminB1_q75': q75,
        'median_periphery_distance_high_LaminB1_um': high_median,
        'median_periphery_distance_low_LaminB1_um': low_median,
        'cell_contrast_high_minus_low_um': float(contrast),
    })
    cell_payloads.append({
        'cell_id': cell_id,
        'cell_type': cell_type,
        'lamin': g['LaminB1'].to_numpy(float),
        'dist': g['n_per_dist(um)'].to_numpy(float),
    })

cell_table = pd.DataFrame(cell_rows)
if len(cell_table) > 0:
    observed_statistic = float(np.median(cell_table['cell_contrast_high_minus_low_um']))
    mean_contrast = float(np.mean(cell_table['cell_contrast_high_minus_low_um']))
    fraction_negative = float((cell_table['cell_contrast_high_minus_low_um'] < 0).mean())
else:
    observed_statistic = np.nan
    mean_contrast = np.nan
    fraction_negative = np.nan

null_distribution = []
if len(cell_payloads) >= 2:
    for _ in range(N_PERMUTATIONS):
        perm_contrasts = []
        for payload in cell_payloads:
            lamin_perm = rng.permutation(payload['lamin'])
            dist = payload['dist']
            q25 = np.quantile(lamin_perm, 0.25)
            q75 = np.quantile(lamin_perm, 0.75)
            low = lamin_perm <= q25
            high = lamin_perm >= q75
            if low.sum() >= 5 and high.sum() >= 5 and q75 > q25:
                perm_contrasts.append(float(np.median(dist[high]) - np.median(dist[low])))
        if len(perm_contrasts) == len(cell_payloads):
            null_distribution.append(float(np.median(perm_contrasts)))
null_distribution = np.asarray(null_distribution, dtype=float)

if len(cell_table) >= 2 and len(null_distribution) >= 100 and np.isfinite(observed_statistic):
    # One-sided lower-tail randomization test: LaminB1-high spots should be closer to lamina, so contrast < 0.
    p_value = float((1 + np.sum(null_distribution <= observed_statistic)) / (len(null_distribution) + 1))
    null_median = float(np.median(null_distribution))
    null_sd = float(np.std(null_distribution, ddof=1)) if len(null_distribution) > 1 else float('nan')
    effect_size = observed_statistic
    hypothesis_test_status = 'pass'
else:
    p_value = 1.0
    null_median = float(np.nanmedian(null_distribution)) if len(null_distribution) else float('nan')
    null_sd = float(np.nanstd(null_distribution, ddof=1)) if len(null_distribution) > 1 else float('nan')
    effect_size = float(observed_statistic) if np.isfinite(observed_statistic) else 0.0
    hypothesis_test_status = 'insufficient_data'

null_hypothesis = 'Within cells, LaminB1 intensities are exchangeable with respect to nuclear-periphery distance; the median high-minus-low distance contrast is no smaller than random label assignments.'
alternative_hypothesis = 'LaminB1-high spots have shorter nuclear-periphery distance than LaminB1-low spots within cells, giving a negative median high-minus-low contrast.'
test_method = f'within-cell LaminB1-label permutation test ({len(null_distribution)} permutations, one-sided lower-tail)'

result_table = cell_table.copy()
for col, val in {
    'observed_statistic_median_cell_contrast_um': observed_statistic,
    'effect_size_median_contrast_um': effect_size,
    'p_value': p_value,
    'test_method': test_method,
    'null_median_contrast_um': null_median,
    'null_sd_contrast_um': null_sd,
    'n_permutations': int(len(null_distribution)),
    'hypothesis_test_status': hypothesis_test_status,
}.items():
    result_table[col] = val

analysis_summary = {
    'idea_id': IDEA.idea_id,
    'parameter_name': 'laminB1_periphery_distance_contrast',
    'parameter_value': float(effect_size),
    'observed_statistic': float(observed_statistic) if np.isfinite(observed_statistic) else 0.0,
    'effect_size': float(effect_size),
    'p_value': float(p_value),
    'test_method': test_method,
    'null_hypothesis': null_hypothesis,
    'alternative_hypothesis': alternative_hypothesis,
    'hypothesis_test_status': hypothesis_test_status,
    'n_selected_cells': int(len(result_table)),
    'n_rows': int(len(result_table)),
    'n_eligible_spots': int(len(eligible_df)),
    'target_cell_types': TARGET_CELL_TYPES,
    'minimum_finite_spots_per_cell': MIN_FINITE_SPOTS_PER_CELL,
    'mean_cell_contrast_um': float(mean_contrast) if np.isfinite(mean_contrast) else None,
    'fraction_cells_negative': float(fraction_negative) if np.isfinite(fraction_negative) else None,
    'null_distribution_median_um': null_median,
    'null_distribution_sd_um': null_sd,
    'negative_control': 'LaminB1 labels were shuffled within each cell to preserve per-cell distances and spot counts.',
    'result_path': REL_RESULT_PATH,
    'statistical_figure_path': REL_FIG_PATH,

# Statistical figure: cell-level observed contrasts and randomization null distribution.
plt.rcParams.update({'figure.facecolor': 'white', 'axes.facecolor': 'white', 'font.size': 10})
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2), constrained_layout=True)
ax = axes[0]
if len(result_table):
    order = TARGET_CELL_TYPES
    x_positions = {ct: i for i, ct in enumerate(order)}
    colors = {'Granule': '#4C78A8', 'Bergmann': '#F58518', 'Purkinje': '#54A24B'}
    for ct in order:
        vals = result_table.loc[result_table['cell_type'] == ct, 'cell_contrast_high_minus_low_um'].to_numpy(float)
        if len(vals):
            jitter = rng.normal(0, 0.035, size=len(vals))
            ax.scatter(np.full(len(vals), x_positions[ct]) + jitter, vals, s=52, color=colors[ct], label=f'{ct} cells', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.4, zorder=3)
            ax.hlines(np.median(vals), x_positions[ct]-0.22, x_positions[ct]+0.22, color=colors[ct], linewidth=2.0)
    ax.axhline(0, color='0.35', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label='no contrast')
    ax.axhline(observed_statistic, color='black', linestyle='-', linewidth=1.8, label='overall median')
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(order)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(order, rotation=20, ha='right')
else:
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No eligible cells', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.set_ylabel('Cell contrast: median distance high LaminB1 − low LaminB1 (µm)')
ax.set_title('Observed within-cell quartile contrasts')
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)

ax = axes[1]
if len(null_distribution):
    ax.hist(null_distribution, bins=30, color='#B8C6D9', edgecolor='white', label='within-cell shuffled null')
    ax.axvline(observed_statistic, color='#C43C39', linewidth=2.2, label='observed median contrast')
    ax.axvline(0, color='0.35', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label='zero contrast')
    ymax = ax.get_ylim()[1]
    annotation = f'p={p_value:.4g}\neffect={effect_size:.4f} µm\nn={len(result_table)} cells\n{len(null_distribution)} permutations'
    ax.text(0.97, 0.95, annotation, transform=ax.transAxes, ha='right', va='top', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor='0.75'))
else:
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'Null distribution unavailable', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.set_xlabel('Median cell contrast under null (µm)')
ax.set_ylabel('Permutation count')
ax.set_title('Hypothesis-test evidence')
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle('LaminB1 boundary-distance contrast test: negative values indicate lamina proximity', fontsize=12)
fig.savefig(fig_path_abs, dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
display(Image(filename=str(fig_path_abs)))

Final interpretation¶

Hypothesis. LaminB1-enriched chromatin loci are preferentially positioned near the nuclear lamina, measurable as shorter nuclear-periphery distance independent of the previously tested radial-score correlation.

Exploration. The notebook operationalized the idea as laminB1_periphery_distance_contrast = median across eligible cells of [median tracks.n_per_dist(um) for top-quartile tracks.LaminB1 spots minus median tracks.n_per_dist(um) for bottom-quartile tracks.LaminB1 spots]. using modalities chromatin_tracing, if_tracks, cell_metadata in cell type(s) Granule, Bergmann, Purkinje. Required data fields checked: coords, spots.cell_id, cells.cell_type, tracks.LaminB1, tracks.n_per_dist(um).

Statistical evidence. U-Chrom runner status: Notebook verified. Test: within-cell LaminB1-label permutation test (500 permutations, one-sided lower-tail). Observed statistic: -0.3382; effect size: -0.3382; parameter value: -0.3382; p-value: 0.001996.

Conclusion. Supported (Expected direction). The observed effect is consistent with the expected direction and passes the nominal p <= 0.05 threshold.

What verification means. Notebook verified means the run passed schema/data checks, produced finite numeric output, and included an explicit p-value/effect-size hypothesis test. It does not mean the biological hypothesis is automatically correct.
